title: Black Turtleneck & Pleated Mini
prompt: An original young woman with long, straight black hair and bangs, wearing black rectangular glasses, walks a runway. She wears a fitted black ribbed turtleneck with a small red emblem, a black pleated mini skirt with a cream ruffled hem, and sheer black tights. A black structured bag hangs from one shoulder, and she wears black mary-jane heels. Her expression is calm and direct. A saturated blue runway backdrop with soft, even light. Palette of black, cream, and cobalt blue. Sharp and graphic, in the style of a minimalist runway show.
workingNotes:
- The glasses and cream ruffled hem are the unexpected touches.
- Keep the blue backdrop for a graphic contrast.
